what.text: This page follows refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo living in Angola, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 22529 of these refugees in Angola, 1.9% of all refugees from the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Uganda hosts the most refugees from the country, followed by Burundi, Zambia and Rwanda.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of DR Congo in 1977 to 1978 and in periods from 1996, at war level in many years.
From 2016 to 2025 the opponents it records include Kamuina Nsapu, RNL, CNPSC and M23, and it also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2017 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1976 at 5000 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 225000, at the end of 1977, the main year of displacement in the data, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Angola.
These are year-end totals for Angola only, reported to UNHCR.
